title: Risk catalogue entry
description: One file under data/catalogue/<category>/<name>.json. The id and the category come from the file path. The file carries neither. The validator (scripts/catalogue/validate.py) checks the cross-field rule half_life_years <= service_life_years, the partner_category list against data/partner-categories.json, and runs tests.match / tests.reject through the reference matcher.

title.description: Short English name shown in the app risk list.

applies_when.description: Condition over the home profile. The entry matches when the condition is true. Semantics per decision 37.

severity.description: Damage size if the risk realises. 1 = small, 5 = loss of the house or life.

probability.description: Chance of the risk realising within the service life. 1 = rare, 5 = expected.

service_life_years.description: Technical service life of the building part in years (RT 18-10922 style).

check_interval_years.description: Years between checks. Drives the maintenance list and the points cooldown.

half_life_years.description: Points decay: decay = 0.5 ^ (years_since / half_life_years). Must be <= service_life_years (checked by the validator).

action.description: What the partner does, one sentence.

partner_category.description: Must equal the list in data/partner-categories.json. The validator checks both lists match.

points.description: Care score points for a confirmed mitigation, before decay.

known_quirks.description: The only place a model may take appliance- or structure-specific claims from (decision 6).

why_hint.description: Draft text the writer model uses for the 'why' sentence.

benefit_hint.description: Draft text the writer model uses for the 'benefit' sentence.

source.description: Where the numbers and claims come from.

on_done.description: The profile fact a confirmed work order writes with source 'partner'.

field.description: A home profile field name. The validator checks it exists in data/home-profile.schema.json.

value.description: A literal for the field, or a sentinel: 'confirmation_date' (ISO date of the confirmation) or 'confirmation_year' (its year).

reject.description: Profiles the entry must not match.

test_profile.description: A profile-like object: field name to plain value, or to {value: ...}. Missing fields count as 'unknown'.

compare.description: lt and gt compare numbers with numbers, or ISO date strings with ISO date strings. Any test against 'unknown' is false, so the literal 'unknown' is not allowed as the value: such a leaf could never match.

in.description: True when the profile value is in the list. 'unknown' matches only when the list contains 'unknown'.

exists.description: True when the profile value is not 'unknown'.
